sources.title: Seven Jing-Zhang room figure-ground snapshots

sources.limitation: Morphology and attachment-condition reading only; not an official boundary, parcel, ownership or vacancy record, building inventory, measured survey, actual gate/access agreement, navigation product or approval. Absence from an extract does not prove physical absence. © OpenStreetMap contributors.

sources.title: Southern Dazhongsi AI cluster planning and renewal context
sources.usage: Official task context for a city-type AI district, low-disturbance renewal, station integration, four-quadrant walking links and public-space improvement.
sources.limitation: Planning task context only; not demolition approval for an identifiable building.

sources.title: Beijing guidance on integrated station-city space
sources.usage: Policy basis for a 300 m core coordination range around rail stations in the central city.
sources.limitation: A coordination range is not a parcel, redline, easement, approval or blanket right to build.

sources.title: Lanjing Lijia municipal transport and planning integration scheme
sources.usage: Project-specific context for a 300 m station-city coordination range and encouraged shared levels B2, B1, ground and 2F.
sources.limitation: Encouraged shared levels are planning guidance, not evidence of completed construction, public access, a public easement or 24-hour opening.

sources.title: Haidian initial planning review letter for Lanjing Lijia
sources.usage: Plan context for two public non-motor parking areas east and west of the planned M12 Dazhongsi E exit, totalling approximately 0.14 ha.
sources.limitation: The 0.14 ha is the combined area of two planned facilities; the source does not prove they have been built or provide surveyed GIS coordinates.

sources.title: Final land-supply review letter for Lanjing Lijia
sources.usage: Requirement for green-space interpenetration with Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park and an above/below-ground slow-mobility link to the station; heritage and archaeology context.
sources.limitation: No exact route, structure, access right or approval is inferred. The absence of above-ground immovable relics in the land-supply application is not evidence that the wider area has no heritage or archaeology.

sources.title: Official Lanjing Lijia position plan
sources.usage: Orientation context for the land package relative to planned M12 and M13A station infrastructure.
sources.limitation: Published straight-line orientation distances are not walking distances, surveyed access routes, metro-protection boundaries or proof of availability.

sources.title: Official Lanjing Lijia land-supply package index
sources.usage: Package-level provenance and published land-supply area for separating the competition area, planning-study area, land-supply parcels and station coordination range.
sources.limitation: A land-supply package is not the 72 ha competition boundary and does not authorise the participant's P0 test location, access or design.

sources.title: Juesheng Temple national key cultural-relic status
sources.usage: Heritage-status context for the nationally protected Juesheng Temple near the Dazhongsi planning package.
sources.limitation: No protection or construction-control buffer is guessed. Official heritage control drawings and authority review must be overlaid before any site decision; the status does not justify pseudo-historic form.

sources.title: NREL Solar Position Algorithm

sources.usage: Pinned implementation/runtime identity for the NREL-SPA study.
sources.limitation: Software validation does not turn the concept-stage model into a statutory insolation, daylight, energy or thermal-comfort calculation.

sources.title: Jing-Zhang Railway heritage history
sources.usage: 1905–1909 railway-history facts.

sources.title: 京张路工撮影 / Jing-Zhang lu gong cuo ying
sources.usage: Four pinned low-resolution album images support a methodological lineage—record, survey, test, evaluate and maintain. Participant labels LINE/STATION/WATER/BUILD are visual readings, not verified image locations or evidence for C1–C7 site conditions.
sources.limitation: Not simplified to public domain. Credit: Tongsheng Photo Studio, Jing-Zhang lu gong cuo ying, 1909; original National Library of China; World Digital Library / Library of Congress, LCCN 2021668851. Cultural and item-level restrictions must still be respected.

sources.title: 北京市责任规划师制度定义
sources.usage: Definition of the area-based responsibility planner as an independent third party providing continuous place-based professional advice and technical service across planning, implementation and co-governance.
sources.limitation: A responsibility planner is proposed as a project role; none is appointed or authorised by this submission.

sources.title: 责任规划师让城市治理‘多全齐美’
sources.usage: Case evidence for one indicator set assessed in parallel by professionals and residents, with disagreement used to bring the weaker result and resident needs forward. The submission adopts this as a voluntary C1–C7 pilot protocol.
sources.limitation: The official article describes a Changping case, not a citywide mandatory standard. No C1–C7 expert or resident scoring has yet occurred; field baselines, participation and accountable review remain required.

sources.title: Interim Measures for Generative AI Services
sources.usage: Bounded public-AI governance context; not individual legal advice.

sources.title: Accessible Environment Construction Law
sources.usage: Accessibility and staffed-service legal context.
sources.limitation: Applied only within the law's actual scope.

sources.title: 建筑与市政工程无障碍通用规范 / GB 55019-2021
sources.usage: Reference basis for accessible-route and low-counter review of the P0 Station Porch.
sources.limitation: Reference basis only. The participant's 3.0 m route, Ø1.50 m turn and two 1.8 m open escape-direction reserves are design targets; the P0 overlay has not been surveyed, reviewed or approved for compliance.

sources.title: 建筑防火通用规范 / GB 55037-2022
sources.usage: Reference basis for later fire and life-safety review of the P0 Station Porch.
sources.limitation: Reference basis only. No claim is made for fire-engine access, occupant load, exit count, width, travel distance, fire-water supply or approval.

sources.title: Official-source index for six innovation districts
sources.usage: Mechanism comparison without media reuse: Singapore one-north, Punggol Digital District, Barcelona 22@, Paris-Saclay, London Knowledge Quarter and Cambridge Kendall Square.
sources.limitation: Narrative comparison only; no imagery, maps, logos or branded layouts reused.

references.title: Kendall Square Public Space Center Plan

sources.title: Open Building: An Approach to Sustainable Architecture
sources.usage: Background for separating long-life support from replaceable infill; submitted design-life values remain participant-authored targets.
sources.limitation: Conceptual precedent only; it does not validate the 100-year support target, structural system or code compliance.

sources.title: Palace Museum research on modularity in Yingzao Fashi
sources.usage: Historical evidence that Chinese construction culture used modular coordination at component, frame and composition scales.
sources.limitation: The project’s 6 m and 8 m grids are contemporary structural choices, not dimensions copied from Yingzao Fashi.

sources.title: Courtyard Hybrid, Beijing
sources.usage: Mechanism precedent for hybrid courtyard life, rotatable interfaces and a concealed public passage.
sources.limitation: Design logic only; no image, drawing or material system is copied.

sources.title: Regeneration and renovation of the remains of Kingway Brewery
sources.usage: Mechanism precedent for retaining industrial evidence while inserting independent contemporary structures and public routes.
sources.limitation: Design logic and stated project facts only; no image, drawing or detail is copied.

sources.title: Nantou Hybrid Building
sources.usage: Mechanism precedent for incremental regeneration, retained urban genealogy and a vertically accessible public micro-complex.
sources.limitation: Shenzhen climate and urban-village conditions are not transferred to Beijing without adaptation; no media is copied.

sources.title: Zhaojunsheng Market renewal and neighbourhood service hall
sources.usage: Beijing evidence for demand research, price-conscious food, repair, all-age comfort, ventilation, drainage, fire safety and an operator-led neighbourhood service hall.
sources.limitation: Old-city market conditions inform programme and operating questions, not a copied architectural form.

sources.title: Spatial integration study of six Xueyuanlu campuses
sources.usage: Evidence supporting limited opening of high-value campus passages rather than blanket removal of boundaries.
sources.limitation: Study findings guide a testable gate strategy; they do not authorise access at any named campus.

sources.title: Approval of Qinghua East Road south-side public-space improvement
sources.usage: Adjacent approved context: seven public-space nodes linking the heritage park, Xiaoyue River, campuses, communities and stations.
sources.limitation: A neighbouring public project; its nodes, scope and delivery are not claimed as part of this submission.

sources.title: Beijing all-age-friendly park construction guide
sources.usage: Technical-stage reference for all-age public space and future field verification.
sources.limitation: The current reference architecture does not claim detailed compliance.

sources.title: Peking University rider-friendly south-gate station
sources.usage: Existing local evidence for a campus threshold with delivery handoff, rest, water and charging.
sources.limitation: Type evidence only; actual rider flows and needs require local measurement.

sources.title: Beijing unmanned-delivery vehicle road-testing rules
sources.usage: Governance context for bounded, permitted, monitored low-speed robot tests.
sources.limitation: Does not grant operating permission within the competition area.
